items.title: Toronto Rock N' Gem Show
items.summary: GET READY! THE MOST ANTICIPATED ROCK N’ GEM SHOW IS COMING! For the FIRST TIME EVER , the Rock N’ Gem Show is taking over The International Centre in Mississauga! Explore an incredible selection of crystals, minerals, fossils, gemstones, jewelry, beads, carvings, lapidary supplies and one-of-a-kind treasures from vendors across Canada. Free parking available. Service animals permitted.

items.title: Luna Halloween Market
items.summary: The Luna Halloween Market: Night of the Vampire brings a weekend of Halloween-themed shopping, entertainment, and family-friendly activities to the Vic Johnston Community Centre. 🌙🖤 Visitors can explore more than 45 unique vendors , immersive vampire-themed photo opportunities, and a variety of spooky attractions throughout the market. Highlights include the 🩸 Blood Bar serving Halloween-inspired beverages, 🍬 Dracula's Candy Bar , the 🎃 Vampire's Cauldron Kids Prize Station , and a 🦇 Vampire Scavenger Hunt with prizes to be won.

items.title: Lakeshore Art Trail
items.summary: Discover, shop, and be inspired at the Lakeshore Art Trail, a weekend celebration of local creativity featuring 40 talented artists showcasing everything from paintings and photography to sculpture and mixed media. Whether you're a serious art collector or just love a good wander, you'll find plenty to explore, plus live demonstrations, artist chats, and interactive experiences along the way. This year is extra special as the Lakeshore Art Trail celebrates 25 years of bringing art and community together.

items.title: The Musical Journey of Neil Diamond featuring Jay White
items.summary: VaughnCo Entertainment proudly presents the world’s most authentic Neil Diamond concert tribute, starring Jay White! For more than five decades, Neil Diamond’s music has transcended generations, touching the hearts of millions around the world. ” Every sound, every gesture, and every note captures the power and emotion that define Neil Diamond’s legendary music. Visually stunning and comfortingly familiar, this extraordinary concert experience is a true feast for the senses—and the soul.

items.title: National Menopause Show
items.summary: Empower your health journey at The National Menopause Show, Canada’s leading consumer event for women navigating perimenopause, menopause, and healthy aging. Taking place on Saturday, October 17 and Sunday, October 18, 2026, at The International Centre in Mississauga, this transformative weekend brings the science and stories of women's health into one supportive space. Attendees can connect with top doctors and medical experts to find real answers about sleep, hormone management, weight, fitness, and intimacy.

items.title: Halloween Harvest Festival
items.summary: Visit Bradley Museum and enjoy all the fall harvest season has to offer!

items.title: The Debut 2026
items.summary: The Debut returns for another unforgettable night of rising hip-hop talent, spotlighting the next generation of artists on a professional stage with a full-scale concert experience to match. This year, RYO, Scartown Koom, Peel Baby JSav, and Seth take over The Rec Room at Square One , delivering exclusive performances and brand-new music that audiences will hear first on debut night.

items.title: Symphony Of Communities
items.summary: What happens when community bands from across Ontario come together on one stage? Find out at Symphony of Communities: When Ontario Plays as One ! Hosted by the Mississauga Pops Concert Band, this lively afternoon concert is part of the Canadian Band Association (Ontario) Community Band Weekend and showcases the energy, passion, and camaraderie of musicians from across the province. Come celebrate community, connection, and great music.

items.title: The Perfect Bite
items.summary: The Perfect Bite , presented by Secret City in collaboration with Netflix , brings its sold-out murder mystery dinner experience to Mississauga, inspired by the thrilling world of Netflix's Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery. Step into an exclusive culinary event hosted by acclaimed Chef Maribelle Moore , where a delicious four-course meal quickly becomes the scene of a gripping mystery . Interact with live actors, uncover secrets, and become part of the story as the evening unfolds around you.

items.title: Preserving Seasonal Food: Quick Pickling Workshop
items.summary: Learn the fast-pickle method to reduce food waste, boost flavor, and enjoy fresh-tasting produce!

items.summary: Recharge your mind and soul with a cozy midday concert series - your perfect lunch hour escape.
